undertale_death_screen.config.shard_rend:
o ante e nasin lukin pi kipisi pilin.
tawa: kipisi li tawa taso.
tawa sike: kipisi li tawa sike taso.
undertale_death_screen.config.music_turn: o pini e kalama musi ali?
sina moli la o pini e kalama ali
undertale_death_screen.config.centered_h: o tawa e pilin lon insa?
o pana e pilin lon insa pi ilo lukin.
pilin li tawa insa pona lon tenpo pini pi pakala ona.
tenpo pi tawa insa pi pilin moli.
undertale_death_screen.config.determinat: o kalama musi (Undertale - Determination) lon tenpo moli.
undertale_death_screen.config.dynamicHea: o ante e kule pilin tan moli lete anu moli ike.
undertale_death_screen.config.background: wawa pi tawa pimeja pi ilo lukin.
undertale_death_screen.config.vanilla_fa: o lukin e lipu moli majuna?
sina pakala la, lipu moli majuna li kama lukin.
tenpo pi kama lukin pi lipu moli (20 = 1 tenpo lili).
undertale_death_screen.config.text_fade_: sitelen 'sina moli!' li kama lukin pona ala pona?
tenpo pi kama lukin lon tenpo lili (20 = tenpo suli 1).
undertale_death_screen.config.fade_to_va: kama lukin e sitelen pi tenpo pini?
pimeja li weka ala weka lon tenpo pini?
undertale_death_screen.config.fixed_anim: tenpo pi tawa li ante ala?
ni li lon la, tenpo tawa li lon 60.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_bu: tu e nena lon tenpo open?
ni li lon la, sina ken ala luka e nena lon tenpo open.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_va: Disables the vanilla red tint around the edges of the screen after death animation.
undertale_death_screen.config.independen: sina wile e ni la kalama musi pi tenpo moli li kute ala e wawa pi kalama musi. ona li kute e wawa pi kalama suli taso.
